pairs.name: Viper
pairs.reason: Viper is going to be able to Break your passive ability and slow your attack speed which is going to significantly reduce your effectiveness and damage output.

pairs.name: Nyx Assassin
pairs.reason: Spiked Carapace can stop Dawnbreaker's Solar Guardian which will eliminate her global presence and limits her movement around the map.

pairs.name: Drow Ranger
pairs.reason: Gust can shut down most of Dawnbreaker's abilities, rendering her useless. Laning is also hard against this ranged carry hero.

pairs.name: Disruptor
pairs.reason: Your ultimate will be a perfect setup for Kinetic Field and Static Storm. You can also not escape from Kinetic Field with your hammer and you can be glimpsed when you land with your ultimate.

pairs.name: Silencer
pairs.reason: Global Silence cancels Dawnbreaker’s ultimate, preventing her from joining fights and reducing her impact during team engagements.

pairs.name: Phoenix
pairs.reason: Phoenix counters Dawnbreaker because she has low attack speed, making it hard to trade damage. Additionally, Phoenix’s supernova is unaffected by Dawnbreaker’s spells, allowing Phoenix to dominate teamfights.
